question: Draft the AWS EA counter-proposal brief for Marcus

intro.title: Meet Priya Nair
intro.text: Procurement Lead, running $92.2M of managed spend across Ariba, SAP, and DocuSign — and this is her workspace at 8 AM.

hero.title: Today's number one job
hero.text: The brief already knows: get the AWS counter-proposal to Marcus Webb before Monday. The $12.0M commit renews September 30.

kpis.title: The scoreboard, live
kpis.text: $6.6M realized savings, $410K ahead of plan. PO cycle time down to 6.4 days. 23 renewals inside the 90-day window.

chart.title: July, explained instantly
chart.text: That $9.42M July spike? An $862K AWS true-up plus Salesforce posting early. August is already back at run-rate.

ask.title: Drag it. Ask it.
ask.text: Priya drops the renewals card into chat and asks for the AWS counter-proposal brief — the day's hardest deliverable.

delegate.title: Delegate the invoice fight
delegate.text: One click chases the Dell invoice block: Amendment 3 pricing reconciled, $8,790 overcharge reversed, corrected invoice due August 15.

autopilot.title: Approvals on autopilot
autopilot.text: Flip the switch — budgeted POs and vetted vendor onboardings clear themselves. Only the Databricks and Adobe calls still need Priya.

mcp.title: Wired into everything
mcp.text: Under the hood: live connections to Ariba, SAP, and DocuSign — eight systems answering in one place, no tab-hopping.

recap.title: Friday report, one click
recap.text: The week writes itself: Dell signed, Adobe in redline, queue cut from 18 to 2. Ready before the boss even asks.

outro.title: Priya negotiates. FoW hustles.
outro.text: The busywork ran itself today. Priya spent her hours on the $12M deal — that's the whole point.
